prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
ai_overview_text:
For a self-employed individual in the Kansas City, Missouri area, AIS Health Insurance Advisors and BBS Insurance are top-rated independent local brokers that specialize in individual and self-employed coverage at no direct cost to the client. BBS Insurance Inc. +1
Services: Provides free, independent guidance on ACA Marketplace individual and family plans, health-sharing programs, Medicare, dental, vision, and supplemental coverage.
Carriers Compared: Compares top major carriers such as Blue Cross Blue Shield of Kansas City, Cigna, Aetna, and Allstate.
Highlights: Led by Travis Allen, operating locally in the Kansas City metro (serving both Missouri and Kansas) without call centers.
Major Carriers: In western Missouri, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Kansas City (Blue KC) is a leading regional carrier, frequently pairing strong local network access (such as Saint Luke’s Health System) with competitive individual rates. Other Marketplace carriers available in the region include Ambetter, Anthem, Medica, Oscar, and UnitedHealthcare. www.forhealthinsurance.com +1
Marketplace vs. Private Plans: As a self-employed freelancer, 1099 contractor, or sole proprietor with no W-2 employees, you can enroll in individual/family coverage through the federal exchange (HealthCare.gov) during Open Enrollment (November 1 to January 15) or via a qualifying life event. Independent brokers can also help evaluate private, off-exchange options side-by-side. HealthCare.gov +2
